summary: Build and scale AI workflows and agents across 9,000+ apps with Zapier—the most connected AI orchestration platform. Trusted by 3 million+ businesses.
description:
Build and scale AI workflows and agents across 9,000+ apps with Zapier—the most connected AI orchestration platform. Trusted by 3 million+ businesses.

App Integration: Connects 6,000+ apps to automate workflows. AI Actions: Automates tasks using natural language prompts. Multi-Step Zaps: Chains multiple tasks together in one automation. Data Formatting: Cleans and reformats data between apps.
